plugins.name: show-me
plugins.description: Stop reading walls of AI text. Say "show me" and Claude renders what it just built as a self-contained page and opens it in your browser before it says a word about it. Two modes: SHOW for one artefact, PICK for a set of directions with a click-to-choose button on each. Handles the part nobody handles, which is that opening a file does not bring the browser forward, so the page sits behind whatever you were looking at and you never see it.
